### Supplemental materials

* [FAA Unmanned Aircraft Systems](https://www.faa.gov/uas/)
* [Becoming a Pilot sUAS Rule (Part 107)](https://www.faa.gov/uas/commercial_operators/become_a_drone_pilot/)
* [Where can I find study materials for the Part 107 aeronautical knowledge test?](https://www.faa.gov/faq/where-can-i-find-study-materials-part-107-aeronautical-knowledge-test)
* [Recreational flyers and TRUST (The Recreational UAS Safety Test)](https://www.faa.gov/uas/recreational_flyers)
* [LAANC airspace authorization and approved service suppliers](https://www.faa.gov/uas/getting_started/laanc)
* [FAADroneZone](https://faadronezone-access.faa.gov/) - registration, waivers, accident reports
* [Operating UAS in North Carolina](https://www.ncdot.gov/aviation/uas/)
* [Drone use in Federally Funded Projects](https://research.ncsu.edu/administration/compliance/research-compliance/research-security/drone-use-in-federally-funded-projects/)
* [UAS Activities at NC State: Rules and Regulations](https://oit.ncsu.edu/about/units/campus-it/rules-and-regulations/uas/)
* Aeronautical charts and related georeferenced data
    * [View digital aeronautical charts](https://vfrmap.com/)
    * [Skyvector](https://skyvector.com/): charts, airspace and airport information for pilots
    * [Download georeferenced digital aeronautical charts](http://www.faa.gov/air_traffic/flight_info/aeronav/digital_products/vfr/), download Charlotte for NC chart
    * [FAA Data Portal](https://www.faa.gov/data)
* Weather data
    * [Aviation Weather Center](https://www.aviationweather.gov/), interactive METAR, TAFs and other NOAA NWS resources
